title: Japanese-Style Pan-Seared Tofu Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Moroccan tagine, this Japanese-inspired dish combines pan-seared tofu with a rich, flavorful sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and pan-fry until golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together mirin, soy sauce, and tagine spice blend.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
